Definition: properly, writing (the art or a document); by implication, a book
BiblicalUsage: Sepher is the book — writing, a letter, a record, a scroll — and it runs through the whole Bible. Genesis opens the book of the generations of Adam, God told Moses to write the defeat of Amalek in a book for a memorial, the priest wrote curses in a book in the trial of jealousy, and every king was to write out a copy of the law in a book and read it all his life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is a God who writes things down, because His people forget and His promises do not. A book outlasts a memory, and that is why the book outlasts the king.
